evals.prompt: run a security review on my changes before I merge this branch
evals.expected_output: A report written to specs/security-review.md scoped to the changed code (git diff main...HEAD + uncommitted working tree). Findings cite the triggered security rule (from the target repo's .cursor/rules/ if present, else the bundled rubric), are graded by severity, and include remediation. A clean diff yields a zero-finding report rather than invented issues.

evals.prompt: audit plugins/boss-dev/agent-harness for security issues and write it to specs/agent-harness-security.md
evals.expected_output: A directory-scoped review of plugins/boss-dev/agent-harness written to the requested path specs/agent-harness-security.md (honoring the path override). Larger target should trigger adaptive fan-out; findings deduped and severity-triaged in the report structure.

evals.prompt: is scripts/validate-unicode-hygiene.py secure? do a security review
evals.expected_output: A single-file, single-context review of scripts/validate-unicode-hygiene.py written to specs/security-review.md (default path). Applies the Python rule file (security-lang-python.mdc) plus relevant global rules, resolved from the live .cursor/rules/ or the bundled copies; reports findings with cited rules, or a clean zero-finding report if the file is safe.
